title: Non-OP Command Blocker
description: This mod blocks selected commands for non-operator players and lets operators manage the block list in-game.
body:
# non-op-command-blocker
This mod blocks the default commands that non-OP players can use when running a Minecraft server.

## By default, it blocks these commands:

- `/help`
- `/list`
- `/me`
- `/msg`
- `/random`
- `/teammsg`
- `/tell`
- `/tm`
- `/trigger`
- `/w`

## Operators can manage the block list in-game with these commands:

- `/cblock <command> block`
- `/cblock <command> allow`

Ex). `/cblock worldedit allow`
Ex). `/cblock spark allow`
Ex). `/cblock vanish allow`


Blocked commands are saved to a config file, so your settings stay after server restarts.

**This mod is designed for server owners who want tighter control over which commands regular players can use, while still allowing operators full access.**

### Requirements

- Minecraft 26.1+
- [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/server/)
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api/versions) (required)
- **Server-side only (clients do not need to install the mod)**

To help us develop a more convenient and better mod, please share any bugs, issues, or feature ideas you have! -> [Bug Report](https://forms.gle/HuWC5xxnuioxgDoy8)
